cluster_summary: The code fails to verify that user-supplied identifiers (such as user IDs, resource IDs, or workspace IDs) are properly authenticated, owned by the requester, or correctly formatted before using them to access or return data. This leads to unauthorized access to private resources, data exposure, and path traversal attacks.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-influenced inputs, resource identities, state values, or configuration described by the member CVEs into the sensitive operation or security boundary described by the member CVEs. Report code paths where the required validation, authorization, isolation, state check, or binding is absent or not connected to the sensitive effect. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should Replace the conditional filter with an unconditional rank-based comparison that always restricts access to users with equal or higher rank than the authenticated user, independent of any user-supplied parameter..

mechanism.name: User-controlled filter flag bypassing authorization restriction

mechanism.typical_fix: Replace the conditional filter with an unconditional rank-based comparison that always restricts access to users with equal or higher rank than the authenticated user, independent of any user-supplied parameter.

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Replace the conditional filter with an unconditional rank-based comparison that always restricts access to users with equal or higher rank than the authenticated user, independent of any user-supplied parameter.
sub_patterns.name: User-controlled filter flag bypassing authorization restriction
sub_patterns.root_cause: A privilege filter (e.g., exclude owner users) is conditionally applied based on an attacker-controlled query parameter. By setting the parameter to a value that skips the filter, an attacker can bypass the restriction and access higher-privilege data.
